faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SVNIT Administrative Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the SVNIT Administrative Assistant position is 17th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be any Engineering graduate from a government-recognized institute or university, with three years of experience in office administration and computer proficiency in MS Office.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Administrative Assistant post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Administrative Assistant post at SVNIT.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the official SVNIT website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the SVNIT Administrative Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Administrative Assistant post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a Contractual job type.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
